I'd buy the Segway Lumina 500 for $199.99. Assuming you mean a portable battery power station for camping or short outages, it offers the best balance of capacity, output and price among the under-$300 listings I found.

Segway Lumina 500

$199.99

Curacao

512Wh LiFePO4 battery, 600W continuous AC output and 1,200W peak. Excellent value for lights, laptops, fans and network equipment.

EcoFlow RIVER 2 Max 500

$289.00

EcoFlow

Best alternative if fast recharging matters: 499Wh, 500W output and a claimed one-hour wall recharge. Sold directly by EcoFlow.

Pecron E500LFP
